description: The models on your disk, put to work. A private desktop app for open models — chat, a coding agent built for small models, text-to-image, answers from your own documents, and voice. GGUF on llama.cpp, MLX on Apple Silicon. macOS, Windows, Linux. No account, no cloud, no telemetry.
summary: Private, on-device AI desktop app — GGUF (llama.cpp) & MLX, with Qwen3.8's native reasoning-effort ladder wired in as a real control. Local coding agent, RAG knowledge base, Deep Research, vision and voice. 100% offline, no account, no telemetry. Windows & macOS.
